title: The Mindmelter (ORIGINAL)
description: It was supposed to be a simple job. Get in, get the evidence, leave. Now you're dangling from the ceiling, completely at my mercy. The question is... Who sent you? You're a government spy sent to foil my dastardly plans for world domination. Fortunately my latex slaves caught you just in time before you could escape the lair with any incriminating evidence. I know you've been trained to withstand intense interrogation so you won't give up your secrets easily. It could take days to break you. I've developed a device for just such a situation and the very tool they sent you here to recover. The Mindmelter No secret is safe with me. Your mind and body will be mush in my hands before I am done with you and you'll be desperate to tell me everything. Absolutely, everything.
author: Mistress Shibby
